description: Tencent Hunyuan 3 (295B mixture-of-experts, 21B active, Apache-2.0) as kodelow's NVFP4 W4A16 quantization (routed experts 4-bit, MTP layer preserved, Marlin kernels) on two Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 2, native MTP speculative decoding (1 token), FP8 KV, eager execution, 128K context and hy_v3 tool and reasoning parsers. Basis: tonyd2wild's recipe. Upstream ran an unpublished local image (vLLM 0.23.1rc1.dev190); this recipe uses the published digest-pinned build of the same vLLM (0.23.1rc1.dev190+gab6660699) and applies upstream's ':opensource' special-token parser patch at build time. Upstream launches with Ray; this recipe uses the platform's native multi-node mp executor, which upstream did not test. The upstream repository declares no licence file. Upstream figures (21.8 tok/s single stream, 59.7 tok/s aggregate at six streams) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: GPU utilization 0.90 → 0.85. Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. This deviates from the upstream memory profile to avoid unified-memory thrashing; context and other kit flags are retained with a smaller KV pool. Absolute KV correction: 21,225,799,680 bytes per rank covers 6 simultaneous full-context requests at 43,184 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound. Context is capped from the creator profile's 131,072 tokens to 43,184 so selected weights, this KV pool and 8 GB runtime overhead remain admissible on an idle Spark; full creator context with this concurrency does not fit. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: Hunyuan 3 (Hy3) 295B NVFP4 MTP vLLM two Sparks
